inputs.consumption_firewall: Use only retained/source-locked exact EX5 interface artifacts. Interface availability does not imply population-wide MAIN credit.

nodes.title: Replay the retained exact Picard64 completion interface and freeze exact input scope
nodes.goal: Identify exact source locks and one current authoritative bounded terminal/block/stratum on which the completion system is fully determined. Do not construct missing EX5 adapter mathematics here.

nodes.title: Finite-ring direct completion obstruction
nodes.goal: Reduce only exact completion consequences modulo bounded finite rings and test whether an exact terminal/block/stratum has empty completion image. Any rejection must be monotone and replayable.

nodes.title: Exact scope and preimage certificate
nodes.goal: Prove the rejected residue/completion scope maps exactly to the claimed FULL178 terminals without population drift or double counting against already consumed MAIN cuts.

nodes.title: Dual/Farkas or exact integer infeasibility fallback
nodes.goal: If modular obstruction is nonexcluding, try exact rational dual infeasibility first; use proof-producing integer-specific certificates only when needed and only on a bounded exact case.

nodes.title: Retained checkpoint and MAIN handoff
nodes.goal: Freeze either a useful exact obstruction candidate, a precise blocker/reopen condition, or a bounded negative result for hostile audit and later MAIN consumption.

anti_duplication.n105_seed_semantics: N105 identified direct Picard modular and dual infeasibility as distinct but previously blocked until an exact completion interface became available.
anti_duplication.ex5_current_semantics: EX5 now reports an exact Picard64 completion interface available, while population-wide MAIN-consumable credit remains incomplete.
anti_duplication.rule: CUT consumes that interface; EX5 produces/refines it. CUT never edits or silently replaces EX5 adapter semantics.
